shortDescription: Configure interface mode port security settings on SONiC.

options.name: config
options.description: Specifies the port security interface configurations.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the operation to be performed on the port security related interfaces configured on the device. In case of merged, the input configuration will be merged with the existing port security interfaces related configuration on the device. In case of deleted, the existing OSPFv2 interfaces configuration will be removed from the device.
